targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly replicate the negative-recency effect attributed to Craik. The new spacing analysis revises the explanation, without denying the original empirical effect.

targets.title: Positive recency in delayed free recall
targets.evidence_quote: Given that previous studies (e.g. Tzeng, 1973 ; Bjork & Whitten, 1974 ) found mixed results, we reexamined the negative-recency effect in final-free recall following both CDFR lists and DFR lists in which there was no inter-item distractor.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors reexamine the prior CDFR findings jointly, but say only that previous studies had mixed results. They do not identify Tzeng’s original negative-recency result separately, so its agreement with the present robust negative recency cannot be determined.
